title: Audit sensor logs, each with its own correction

goal.title: Primary audit and final artifact
goal.text: Own the complete audit described in TASK.md. Read all sensor correction notes, compute the requested fields with a local script and produce the single final answers.json in your workspace. Report the exact file once checked.
goal.rubric: Apply each file's correction before computation. Return compact notes and summaries to model context and keep raw rows in the workspace. Verify coverage and rounding before reporting.

goal.title: Independent audit check
goal.text: Independently check the interpretation of TASK.md and test representative sensors from the different correction types. Report reproducible examples and potential edge cases for the delivery owner.
goal.rubric: Keep raw rows in the workspace. Verify the sampled calculations against the written spec. The primary worker owns the final answers.json.

goal: Audit all sensor logs in data/ using the per-file corrections in their notes. Deliver the JSON outputs specified by TASK.md together in one workspace.
rubric: The hidden grader checks every field against the definitions, corrections and rounding rules in TASK.md.
